column1: # Generated by GAMA and read by Unity. Only 'key' and 'value' are read;
# the other columns are documentation and may be reordered or extended.
# apply_scope says when a value sent mid-session can take effect:
#   next_day          - from the next simulated day
#   future_infections - only for people infected after the change
#   next_session      - not until the neighbourhood is rebuilt

column6: notes
Bite to symptoms, shortest. Design section 5: four to ten days. Do not compress.
Bite to symptoms, longest.
Febrile period, shortest.
Febrile period, longest.
Viraemia begins this many days before symptoms.
Last day a patient can infect a mosquito, counted from symptom onset.
Share of infections that never feel ill. Section 5: half to three quarters. Pending Dr Marcombe.
Length of the infectious window for someone with no symptoms.
How infectious to mosquitoes a symptomless case is, relative to a febrile one. Section 5: virus levels peak during fever. Below 1, or netting the visible patients stops being the strongest action.
Background rate of bleeding or persistent vomiting among symptomatic cases.
Earliest warning-sign onset relative to the end of fever. Section 8: danger arrives as the fever comes down.
Latest warning-sign onset relative to the end of fever.
How long before an unreferred household takes itself to hospital. A consequence shown to the player, never a penalty.
Shortest time before a mosquito that fed on a case can transmit. Section 5: eight to twelve days.
Longest extrinsic incubation period.
Shortest adult female lifespan.
Longest adult female lifespan.
Adults emerging from each productive container each day. The main lever the GAMA container model drives.
Ceiling per plot, so a neglected neighbourhood stays playable.
Days' worth of emergence already on the wing on day one. Section 5: the mosquitoes are already flying.
Chance a given mosquito seeks a blood meal on a given day.
Chance of moving to an adjacent plot. Aedes aegypti travels very little.
Chance a bite on an infectious person infects the mosquito.
Chance a bite by an infectious mosquito infects the person.
Bite risk under a net while lying down during the day. The strongest measure in the module.
The same net over someone up and about - close to no protection, because they are not under it when Aedes bites. Must stay well above net_over_resting_person.
Window and door screens in good repair.
A screen with a hole in it - close to useless, which is why repairing it is worth the player's time.
Shutting up after dawn and before dusk. Costs nothing, available to everyone.
Air movement disrupts flight and the plume mosquitoes home in on.
Include it, but the module must not depend on it - uncommon in these households.
Applied to exposed skin.
How long one application lasts.
Free, and uncomfortable with a fever.
Must be fewer than the number of households. Section 5: the choice is the whole point.
Section 8: two to four minutes, fixed in playtesting.
One per squad member.
Five or six makes a session.
How far the calendar jumps when the headset changes hands.
Section 11: eight to ten plots along two or three lanes.
Number of lanes.
What the squad cleared in Module 2. Open question 3b - this is how that state carries over.
How long the first patients have been ill when the squad arrives.
Section 5: one chain must begin where nobody was ever visibly ill.
Cryptic sites no sweep finds. Why perfect prevention still leaves mosquitoes.
Teaching guarantee, not a clinical rate: how many referral situations a session must present.
